initialization.scope: Long-term charter, baseline, prerequisites, coordination guard, first milestones and scheduling verification. No game feature or new public release in this setup.
initialization.controlPlaneCommit: The Git commit containing this file; game source/deployment identities are recorded separately below.

baseline.portability: Remote normal source/gh-pages commits and manifest are the durable restore anchors. Temporary players and ignored raw Artifacts must be checked for existence; never assume a new environment retains them.

PathOfDawn.lastCompleteProductValidation: Nativity historical: Core/native/Web/6browser profiles and live release; see Docs/NativityValidation.md. Not rerun as complete gameplay in this setup.

FantasyCards.fidelityBaseline: 2016 preserved official FAQ and date-verified 2017 screens; old2005 manual explicitly supplemental, final pre-shutdown patch identity not proven.
FantasyCards.assetRedistributionStatus: Existing blanket permission unconfirmed; no new third-party public assets authorized without verification.

currentObservedChecks.scope: Current prerequisite checks, real remote contention, HTTP manifest/HTML and actual ordinary desktop entry only. No new complete native/build/gameplay/save/touch/PCM/performance pass.
currentObservedChecks.titleCaptureLimit: Two prematurely named title frames are Unity splash diagnostics, not approved game title screenshots.

tasks: Minimally parameterize existing source-bound runner output paths for unique evidence; check storage and budget first.
Keep nativity opening; replace full-screen field NPC story painting with in-place dialogue preserving citation, voice and save semantics.
Clarify next encounter direction/distance/talk-ready state for Joseph, Mary and temple.
nextRun.acceptance: Actual movement through first three encounters, first field passage, book entry, save and full reconnect to identical place/dialogue. Core/native + new PC/touch Web/visual/input/reload checks before same-site publication.
nextRun.resumeAt: Read these four files, inspect actual remote/current dirty work and active owners, acquire remote lease; verify runtime/licensing/storage; begin G1 tasks without asking routine preferences.

overrides: Continue unfinished work before starting an unrelated milestone

execution.singleOwnerPolicy: Current root was active and acquired real lease. Future runs use the actual lease holder, not historical agent names.
execution.lockStatus: Query live at each run; STATE.json is not a live lock or permission token.
execution.onBusyOrUnknown: Skip current cycle with exit75; do not queue or automatically steal even expired locks.
execution.limitsNote: run enforces its child process group only. A scheduled task runner must separately enforce entire agent time/usage/concurrency. Never raise limits or disable stops automatically.
execution.evidencePolicy: Unique Artifacts/Validation/Autonomy/<run-id>; retain all historical originals/GUID/save/ZIP/failures. Raw Artifacts are ignored; durable baseline/check summaries and next work are in these committed files.

environment.pythonNote: Default Python lacks requests. Initial probe reused existing installed requests via command-scoped PYTHONPATH; no install. Check actual availability on each environment.

runtimeRetry.source: Observed normal official CLI status result from the bounded elevated check-runtime.py retry; credential values never read or emitted.
runtimeRetry.retainedInitialFailure: runtime-probe.json unity-license exit6 LOCAL_STORE_UNWRITABLE; no failure converted to pass

environment.note: Editor version/license are current; no fresh compile or full game test was needed for documentation/guard-only initialization.

capacity.basis: Actual stat of all staged files; unchanged public manifest exact SHA. Not a new full GET audit.
capacity.largeAssetGate: Inspect BuildReport and actual unused Resources, preserve originals/GUID/ledger and quality; measure candidate build+all content before adoption. No assumed savings from lazy loading or JPEG/gzip recompression.

automation.onceUserSetup: When creating a future recurring task, attach firstgame and the same managed Unity environment. Start by reading root AGENTS and STATE. Its first actual run must verify runtime/license/Git/lease and configured agent time/usage limits. Do not replace with a paid/self-hosted service without approval.
automation.currentAvailableScope: Autonomous work in active chat using current installed tools and existing Git/Pages procedures; actual new product changes require full current scope-appropriate checks.

authorized: Code and original/licensed asset improvements within charter
Relevant tests and preserved save migrations
Verified builds to existing firstgame Pages
notAuthorizedWithoutSeparateApproval: New paid infrastructure/API fees/asset purchases/real payments
Engine replacement or large genre change
Publish new third-party assets with unconfirmed rights
permissions.branchProtectionRead: 403 Resource not accessible by integration; not treated as no protection or bypass permission. Normal source rights/push are checked through ordinary operations.
